The proposed patch aims to enhance the performance of the data processing module by optimizing the algorithm used for data sorting. Key changes include:
- **Algorithm Update**: Replacing the existing sorting algorithm with a more efficient one (QuickSort) to reduce time complexity from O(n^2) to O(n log n).
- **Code Refactoring**: Streamlining the code for better readability and maintainability.
- **Testing Enhancements**: Adding unit tests to cover edge cases and ensure robustness.

Expected outcomes include improved processing speed and reduced resource consumption during data handling.
